title: New York and Los Angeles sidemen versus New Orleans players
summary: Sidemen elsewhere were professional and versatile; some New Orleans musicians were great but unprepared, and a clique of session regulars like Earl Palmer got the calls on head sessions.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene
